an occasional visitor: My uncle lives abroad, so he is only an occasional visitor who comes to see us once every few years.
我叔叔住在國外，所以他只是偶爾來的訪客，每隔幾年才來看我們一次。
the occasional cigarette: My father quit smoking years ago, but he still enjoys the occasional cigarette at a friend's wedding.
我爸爸多年前就戒菸了，但在朋友的婚禮上他仍會享受偶爾抽的一根煙。
occasional showers: The weather will be mostly sunny tomorrow, with occasional showers in the mountains in the afternoon.
明天天氣大致晴朗，下午山區會有偶陣雨。
an occasional table: We put an occasional table next to the sofa to hold a small lamp and a few magazines.
我們在沙發旁放了一張小邊桌，用來擺一盞小檯燈和幾本雜誌。
odd jobs: During the summer vacation, Kevin did odd jobs like washing cars and walking dogs to earn some pocket money.
暑假期間，凱文做洗車、遛狗之類的零工來賺點零用錢。
the odd one out: Everyone in my family loves spicy food except me, so I always feel like the odd one out at dinner.
我家除了我以外每個人都愛吃辣，所以吃晚餐時我總覺得自己是格格不入者。
odd numbers: The teacher asked us to answer only the odd numbers, such as questions one, three, and five, for homework.
老師要我們作業只寫奇數題，像是第一、三、五題。
odd socks: In a hurry this morning, Ben went to school wearing odd socks, one red and one blue.
今天早上匆忙之中，班穿著不成對的襪子去上學，一隻紅的一隻藍的。
against all odds: Against all odds, the small school's basketball team beat the champions and won the national title.
這所小學校的籃球隊克服一切困難，打敗了冠軍隊，贏得全國冠軍。
the odd mistake: Your essay is excellent; apart from the odd mistake in spelling here and there, it is nearly perfect.
你的作文很棒；除了這裡那裡偶爾的拼字錯誤之外，幾乎完美。
odds and ends: Grandpa keeps a box of odds and ends, like old keys, buttons, and broken watches, in the garage.
爺爺在車庫裡放了一盒零碎的東西，像是舊鑰匙、鈕扣和壞掉的手錶。
It's odd that…: It's odd that Amy hasn't answered my messages all day, because she usually replies within minutes.
艾美一整天都沒回我訊息真奇怪，因為她通常幾分鐘內就會回覆。
offensive language: The online game bans players who use offensive language or insult others in the chat room.
這款線上遊戲會封鎖在聊天室使用冒犯性的言語或辱罵他人的玩家。
an offensive weapon: The police arrested the man because he was carrying an offensive weapon, a long knife, on the crowded street.
警方逮捕了那名男子，因為他在擁擠的街上攜帶攻擊性武器——一把長刀。
go on the offensive: After losing the first half, the team decided to go on the offensive and attack more in the second half.
上半場落後後，球隊決定採取攻勢，在下半場更積極進攻。
be offensive to: The comedian's jokes were offensive to many older people, and he later apologized on social media.
那位喜劇演員的笑話對許多長者是侮辱，他後來在社群媒體上道歉。
an offensive smell: An offensive smell came from the trash can in the kitchen because no one had emptied it for a week.
廚房垃圾桶傳出難聞的氣味，因為一個星期都沒人去倒。
an olive branch: After their fight, Lisa sent her best friend a card as an olive branch, hoping they could make peace.
吵架之後，麗莎寄了一張卡片給她最好的朋友當作橄欖枝，希望兩人能和好。
hold out an olive branch: After years of argument, the two neighbors finally decided to hold out an olive branch and talk calmly.
爭吵多年後，這兩位鄰居終於決定伸出橄欖枝求和，平心靜氣地談一談。
olive oil: My mom always cooks with olive oil because she believes it is healthier than other kinds of oil.
我媽媽總是用橄欖油做菜，因為她相信它比其他種類的油更健康。
olive skin: The model has dark hair and olive skin, a look that is common in countries around the Mediterranean Sea.
這位模特兒有深色頭髮和橄欖色皮膚，這種外貌在地中海周圍的國家很常見。
an ongoing process: Learning a language is an ongoing process; you have to keep practicing even after you pass the exam.
學習語言是一個持續進行中的過程；即使通過考試之後，你也得持續練習。
an ongoing investigation: The police refused to answer reporters' questions because the case was still an ongoing investigation.
警方拒絕回答記者的問題，因為此案仍是進行中的調查。
ongoing support: After the earthquake, the families received ongoing support from volunteers for many months.
地震之後，這些家庭在好幾個月裡都獲得志工持續的支持。
an ongoing debate: There is an ongoing debate in Taiwan about whether students should be allowed to use phones in class.
台灣對於是否應允許學生在課堂上使用手機，一直有持續的辯論。
be fully operational: The new MRT line is expected to be fully operational by next spring, with all stations open to the public.
新的捷運線預計明年春天全面運作，所有車站都將對大眾開放。
operational costs: To cut operational costs, the restaurant started using less electricity and buying vegetables directly from farmers.
為了降低營運成本，這家餐廳開始減少用電，並直接向農夫購買蔬菜。
operational efficiency: The factory bought new machines to improve operational efficiency, so it can make more products in less time.
工廠購買新機器來提升營運效率，以便在更短時間內生產更多產品。
become operational: The new hospital will become operational next month, when the first patients are allowed to visit.
新醫院將在下個月開始運作，屆時第一批病人就能前來就診。
